prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1064; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the claimant in connection with the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, please provide a complete copy of the liability policy in force on the date of loss, including the declarations page, and confirm the applicable bodily injury and property damage limits in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle data, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until the matter is resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
